svg.text: Flow 08 Adding, editing and deleting products (Admin)
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
• Form checks (web), each shown under its field: name required; price ₱0.00 or more; cost blank or ₱0.00 or more;
preparation time whole minutes 0–120; stock and minimum whole numbers, or a recipe with at least one complete
• Only an Admin can open Products; the API refuses product changes from Staff (authorize("admin")).
• Cancel in the form or the delete dialog closes it without changes. The form also sets ingredients, allergens (a
checklist, with suggestions from the ingredients) and nutrition per serving, typed, looked up in USDA FoodData
Central, or calculated from the recipe (12b, 12c, 14d).
